description: Simulation Toolkit for Electrical Power Systems (STEPS), published by changgang, solves power flow, short-circuit and dynamic simulation problems for balanced large AC-DC power systems, with formats based on PSS/E raw, seq and dyr files. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The maintainer says GitHub may lag behind Gitee; main and development branches serve different purposes. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
